scripts.build: vue-tsc --noEmit && bun run build:client && bun run build:server
scripts.build:min: vue-tsc --noEmit && bun run build:client -- --minify && bun run build:server -- --minify
scripts.crate: bun run crate:svg && bun run crate:reg && bun run crate:tray
scripts.crate:svg: cd crates/convert-svg && cargo build --release && mv -f target/release/convert-svg.exe ../../node_modules/.bin/
scripts.crate:reg: cd crates/reg-utils && cargo build --release && mv -f target/release/reg-utils.exe ../../dist/
scripts.crate:tray: cd crates/tray && cargo build --release && mv -f target/release/tray.dll ../../dist/
scripts.tar: tar cf metadata-fetcher.tar LICENSE\* deno.json \*.md run.bat lib/\*.ts dist/\*
scripts.zip: 7z a metadata-fetcher.zip -- LICENSE\* deno.json \*.md run.bat lib/\*.ts dist/\*
scripts.7z: 7z a metadata-fetcher.7z -m0=LZMA2 -mx=9 -mhc=off -ms=on -mqs=on -- LICENSE\* deno.json \*.md run.bat lib/\*.ts dist/\*
